## `client.namespaces`

The `namespaces` resource of the platform API.

### `client.namespaces.create`

Signature: `client.namespaces.create(environment: str, namespace: str, properties: dict[str, str] | None = None, *, break_glass_reason: str | None = None) -> Namespace`

Create a namespace.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment name. |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | Dot-joined namespace path, such as `"gold.sales"`. |
| `properties` | `dict[str, str] | None` | `None` | Free-form metadata. |
| `break_glass_reason` | `str | None` | `None` | Write to a protected environment outside a run: 10-500 characters, needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT`, audited. The next run of the deployed code may overwrite the fix. |

Returns: `Namespace`. The created namespace.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the environment does not exist. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If a namespace of this path already exists. |

### `client.namespaces.list`

Signature: `client.namespaces.list(environment: str, *, parent: str | None = None, depth: int | None = None, limit: int | None = None, cursor: str | None = None) -> list[Namespace]`

List the namespaces in an environment, in path order.

The namespaces of one page; `list_page` also returns the cursor of the next one, and `iter` walks every page.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment name. |
| `parent` | `str | None` | `None` | Dot-joined path; only the namespaces below it, at every depth. |
| `depth` | `int | None` | `None` | ``1`` keeps only the direct children of `parent` (the top level without one). |
| `limit` | `int | None` | `None` | Most namespaces returned (1 to 200); `None` leaves it to the server (100). |
| `cursor` | `str | None` | `None` | A previous page's `next_cursor`. Send the same `parent` and `depth`. |

Returns: `list of Namespace`. The namespaces of this page.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the environment does not exist. |

### `client.namespaces.list_page`

Signature: `client.namespaces.list_page(environment: str, *, parent: str | None = None, depth: int | None = None, limit: int | None = None, cursor: str | None = None) -> NamespacePage`

List one page of the namespaces, with the cursor of the next page.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment name. |
| `parent` | `str | None` | `None` | Dot-joined path of a namespace: keep only what lies below it, at every depth. |
| `depth` | `int | None` | `None` | ``1`` keeps the direct children of `parent` only (the top level when there is no `parent`). |
| `limit` | `int | None` | `None` | Page size, 1 to 200; `None` takes the server's default of 100. |
| `cursor` | `str | None` | `None` | The `next_cursor` of the page before this one, with the same `parent` and `depth`. |

Returns: `NamespacePage`. The namespaces, and the cursor for the next page (`None` on the last).

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If the environment does not exist. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If `depth` is not 1, or `cursor` is not one the server issued. |

### `client.namespaces.iter`

Signature: `client.namespaces.iter(environment: str, *, parent: str | None = None, depth: int | None = None, page_size: int = 100) -> Iterator[Namespace]`

Yield every matching namespace, in path order, fetching pages as needed.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment name. |
| `parent` | `str | None` | `None` | Dot-joined path; only the namespaces below it, at every depth. |
| `depth` | `int | None` | `None` | ``1`` keeps only the direct children of `parent` (the top level without one). |
| `page_size` | `int` | `100` | Namespaces per request (1 to 200). |

Returns: `Iterator of Namespace`. Each namespace, once.

### `client.namespaces.delete`

Signature: `client.namespaces.delete(environment: str, namespace: str, *, break_glass_reason: str | None = None) -> None`

Drop a namespace.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | The environment name. |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | Dot-joined namespace path. |
| `break_glass_reason` | `str | None` | `None` | Write to a protected environment outside a run: 10-500 characters, needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT`, audited. The next run of the deployed code may overwrite the fix. |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.NotFound` | If no such namespace exists. |
| `lakana.Conflict` | If the namespace still contains tables or child namespaces. |
